SpiritDescription.SourceString:
Increases the chance to trigger a "Spirit Refund" whenever you use an ability that costs Burning Embers, causing you to refund any Burning Embers spent when using that ability.

You also gain "Rising Spirit" for 10 seconds, increasing your Intellect by 5%.

Each time you trigger the "Spirit Refund" you gain 1 Spirit Point toward your Spirit Ability charge.

HeroDescription.SourceString:
Ardeos is a cocky Spellcasting Damage Dealer who utilizes powerful Damage over Time effects. The fact that others have struggled to utilize such raw power doesn’t concern him, he’s found it to be a snap!

Ardeos utilizes a system called Embers and Burning Embers. When he uses his basic abilities he collects the remaining Embers of the spellcast. When enough Embers have been collected they are set ablaze as Burning Embers.

The Burning Embers can be spent to cast Detonate, causing your fiery Damage over Time effects to contribute to instantanous burst damage.

Biography.SourceString:
An exceptional pyromancer too powerful for the academies and too reckless to leave to his own devices.

Ardeos joins the Fellowship to prove his flame will forge him into a hero, not an omen of apocalypse.

RoleMechanics.SourceString:
<rt.debuff>Damage Dealers (DPS)</> are primarily responsible for the following mechanics:
  •   <rt.debuff>Crowd Control (CC)</>
      •   Every Damage Dealer Hero has abilities than can <rt.Bold>Interrupt, Slow, Stun, and/or Reposition</> enemies.
           •    These should be used frequently to increase your party’s chances of survival.
           •    More of these abilities unlock upon completing higher mission difficulties.
      •   Enemy abilities that are interruptible are indicated by <rt.Bold>Yellow Cast Bars</> underneath enemy Health Bars.

  •   <rt.debuff>Dealing Damage</>
      •   Every hero has a <rt.Bold>Core Rotation</>, which is usually the optimal use of several abilities for best effect.
           •    For Damage Dealers especially, learning their Core Rotation, and when to deviate is the key to mastery!
      •   Damage Dealer Heroes define the duration of combat as they generally deal the majority of the damage.
      •   Keeping an eye on the <rt.Bold>Damage Meter</> helps to compare the damage across the group.
           •   The Damage Meter is also a good indicator to understand how well you are playing.
      •   Many damaging abilities excel at either <rt.Bold>single-target damage</>, or dealing damage to <rt.Bold>groups of enemies</>.

  •  <rt.debuff>Surviving</>
      •   Keep an eye on the battlefield to avoid dangerous enemy attacks! 
           •    A dead Damage Dealer kills nothing.
      •   Damage Dealers have at least one ability to help them with <rt.Bold>mobility</> and to <rt.Bold>reduce incoming damage</>.

<rt.debuff>Damage Dealer Tips:</>
  •   Don't stand in <rt.Bold>Area of Effect spells</> on the ground. Use mobility and damage mitigation abilities to survive!
  •   Use <rt.Bold>[Tab]</> to quickly cycle through enemies that are in front of you.
  •   Pick your targets wisely!
      •   Focusing on the most dangerous enemy with the other Damage Dealer can protect your party.
      •   Attacking the target of the tank can help you avoid getting <rt.Bold>Aggro</>.
      •   Finishing off enemies with low health will support your Tank and Healer.

  •   Don't stand in <rt.Bold>Area of Effect spells</> on the ground. Use mobility and damage mitigation abilities to survive!
  •   Use <rt.Bold>[Tab]</> to quickly cycle through enemies that are in front of you.
  •   Pick your targets wisely!
      •   Focusing on the most dangerous enemy with the other Damage Dealer can protect your party.
      •   Attacking the target of the tank can help you avoid getting <rt.Bold>Aggro</>.
      •   Finishing off enemies with low health will support your Tank and Healer.

HeroMechanics.SourceString:
Tariq is a close-combat hero, and fights mainly in melee range with instant cast abilities.
Enemies need to be selected, within range, and in front of him.

Tariq’s unique Hero Mechanics:
  •   <rt.debuff>Swing Timer</> displays the timing on Tariq’s auto-attacks.
      •   If a <rt.Bold>Heavy Strike</> is readied when the Swing Timer triggers an auto-attack it will deal immense damage.
           •    All of Tariq’s other abilities will <rt.Bold>cancel</> Heavy Strike.
           •    Heavy strike should be the <rt.Bold>last ability</> used before the Swing Timer triggers an auto-attack.
           •    Heavy Strike must be cast before the timer passes the <rt.Bold>‘Red’ portion</> of the Swing Timer.
           •    This ability is <rt.Bold>not affected by Global Cooldowns</> (The minimum time between using abilities)
      •   Some abilities do not disrupt the Swing Timer, such as <rt.Bold>Wild Swing</> and <rt.Bold>Face Breaker</>.
      •   Some abilities interrupt and reset the Swing Timer, such as <rt.Bold>Skull Crusher</> and <rt.Bold>Hammer Storm</>.

  •   <rt.debuff>Fury</> is your Builder/Spender resource
      •   Max 100 Fury can be held at a time.
      •   This is built by dealing damage with some abilities, such as <rt.Bold>Heavy Strike</> and <rt.Bold>Wild Swing</>.
      •   Some abilities build a set amount of Fury, such as <rt.Bold>Leap Smash</> and <rt.Bold>Thunder Call</>.
      •   Fury is spent on powerful abilities like <rt.Bold>Skull Crusher</> and <rt.Bold>Hammer Storm</>.

  •   <rt.debuff>Thunder Call</> is an ability that empowers some of your other abilities for a short time.
      •   Heavy Strike deals more damage to your target, and also deals damage to <rt.Bold>enemies around your target</>.
      •   Fury Spenders, such as <rt.Bold>Skull Crusher</> and <rt.Bold>Hammer Storm</>, deal much higher damage.
      •   <rt.Bold>Chain Lightning</> can only be cast while Tariq is empowered by <rt.Bold>Thunder Call</>.

  •   <rt.debuff>Spirit Ability - Raging Tempest</>
      •   Tariq gains an <rt.Bold>enhanced form</> of Thundercall for a short duration.
      •   He also gains <rt.Bold>Raging Currents</> which strikes nearby enemies with lightning.
           •    In addition to dealing damage, each lightning strike also grants a bonus to Tariq’s <rt.Bold>Critical Hit chance</>.
      •   Tariq also gains 30% haste for 20 seconds.

<rt.debuff>Tariq:</>
  •   Squeeze in as many <rt.Bold>Wild Swings</> and <rt.Bold>Face Breakers</> into the Swing Timer before using <rt.Bold>Heavy Strike</>.
  •   <rt.Bold>Heavy Strike</> isn’t affected by Global Cooldowns, so you can use it instantly after another ability.
  •   <rt.Bold>Face Breaker</> deals damage but can only be used when you <rt.Bold>Miss</> your target.
      •   Try to use this ability quickly so the next miss can make it available again.
  •   <rt.Bold>Leap Smash</> can be used to deal damage, but it can also be used to avoid dangerous situations.
  •   <rt.Bold>Unbreakable Will</> can allow Tariq to <rt.Bold>Tank temporarily</>, by giving him a <rt.Bold>Taunt</> and mitigating damage.
      •   Use this ability defensively to survive, or to save an ally in danger.
      •   Taunting can cause the <rt.Bold>Tank to panic</> when they lose Aggro. Choose your targets wisely!
  •   <rt.Bold>Thunder Call</> should be used when facing groups of enemies or spending Fury.
  •   <rt.Bold>Intimidate</> will cause nearby enemies to flee in terror, but they will not run far.
  •   <rt.Bold>Culling Strike</> can deal immense damage to enemies with <rt.Bold>less than 30% health</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Grants access to <rt.mana>Finishing Moves</>  based on <rt.mana>Combo Builders</> used:

<rt.meikoability2>Finisher Techniques can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.meikoability1>PALM TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability1>Double Palm Strike</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Grants <rt.bold>+20% Magic Damage reduction</> & <rt.bold>+5% Parry</> for 30 sec.
<rt.meikoability1>Spirited Vortex</>  (CORE ABILITY)
• Conjures a Vortex around you that provides <rt.bold>+15% Dodge</>, deals damage to nearby enemies over 30 seconds, reduces their movement speed by 35% for 5 seconds and reduces their damage by 10% for 5 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>KICK TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability2>Rising Storm</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Stormfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Lashing Stormkicks by 100%.
<rt.meikoability2>Lashing Stormkick</> (POWER ABILITY)
• Deals damage to target and nearby enemies nearby. Heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.

<rt.meikoability3>FIST TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability3>Rising Earth</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Earthfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Earthfist Barrages by 100%.
<rt.meikoability3>Earthfist Barrage</> (POWER ABILITY)
• Pummels target enemy over 1 second and heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.

Text.SourceString:

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Your <rt.absorb>Double Palm Strike</> finisher applies <bold>Forbidden Technique</> to the target for 15 seconds.

<bold>Forbidden Technique</> accumulates 18% of all damage you deal to the target. Once it expires, is removed, or if the enemy dies while it is active -  the accumulated amount explodes on the target and onto nearby enemies. You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt by <bold>Forbidden Technique</>.

You can only have one <bold>Forbidden Technique</> active at any time.

SpiritDescription.SourceString:
Increases the chance to trigger a "Spirit Refund" whenever you use an ability that costs Mana, causing you to instantly refund the Mana cost of that ability.

Xavian's Brilliant Flash ability has a chance equal to your Spirit to trigger a 'Spirit Refund' even though it does not have a Mana cost. When it does, you instantly gain 50 Mana.

Xavian's passive Mana Generation is increased by an amount equal to your Spirit.

Each time you trigger the "Spirit Refund" you gain 1 Spirit Point toward your Spirit Ability charge.

HeroDescription.SourceString:
A frontline tank with heavy support capabilities, Xavian delivers fast, aggressive gameplay and powerful blows.

Xavian is a Melee Support Tank that excels at protecting his allies while helping keep the party alive and healthy.

His Swift Reprisal Mechanic enables frequent use of his abilities, supporting both survivability and offensive pressure. Brilliant Flash creates a damage-and-healing combo that provides strong self-sustain, while also extending the duration of Shining Halo when triggered.

Mana is Xavian’s main resource, used to fuel healing and high-impact abilities.

Biography.SourceString:
The fall of Azamir is a legend; a tale of hubris for defying the gods and meddling with power they shouldn’t control. Those that escaped the gods’ wrath made new homes throughout the lands, and began to build new lives, to forget. As a child, the prince was smuggled to safety and raised in foreign lands, seeing injustice and cruelty firsthand.

Now a king without a kingdom, Xavian joins the Fellowship helping those he can, wielding the Light of Azamir to keep the dream of their ideals alive, to best represent what his people believed in. While some look at his family sigil in jest, he wears it with pride knowing his people will endure.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: When you cast <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> on yourself, it grants you <rt.effect>Magic Ward</>, reducing all Magic Damage taken by 30% for 4 seconds.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Each time you successfully <rt.bold>Parry</> an attack you are granted 1 stack of <rt.effect>Solar Vanguard</> for 30 seconds.

<rt.effect>Solar Vanguard</> increases the power of your next <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> by <rt.heal>1% per stack</>. Stacks up to 30 times.

<rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> consumes all stacks of <rt.effect>Solar Vanguard</>.

Each time you successfully <rt.bold>Parry</> an attack you are granted 1 stack of <rt.effect>Solar Vanguard</> for 30 seconds.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Each time you <rt.bold>Parry</> an attack you automatically <rt.effect>counter-attack</> that enemy for <rt.warning>116% Strength physical damage</> and <rt.mana>gain 0.5% Mana</>.

Each successful <rt.bold>Parry</> also grants you the <rt.effect>Vanguard of Vengeance</> buff for 20 seconds, stacking up to 20 times - increasing your <rt.warning>Spirit by +0.5% per stack</>.

Your <rt.bold>Parry</> chance is increased by +10%.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Your <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> gains additional benefits from your secondary stats.

<rt.bold>Critical Strike Chance</>
When you activate <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> you <rt.warning>deal damage to all nearby enemies</> equal to 1% of the maximum absorb value for every 1% Critical Strike chance you have.

<rt.bold>Haste</>
While <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> is active on anyone, <rt.bold>your</> Cooldown Recovery is increased by 1% for every 3% Haste you have.

<rt.bold>Expertise</>
While <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> is active, the target's Armor is increased by an amount equal to your Expertise %.

<rt.bold>Spirit</>
Your <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> ability cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds each time you trigger a <rt.effect>Spirit Refund</>.

DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: The <rt.bold>absorb shield</> from your <rt.effect>Empowered Shield Slams</> takes <rt.bold>20% reduced damage</> & enemies that attack you while it is active take <rt.warning>50% Strength</> physical damage.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Your <rt.absorb>Hold the Line</> cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds each time you use <rt.absorb>Shields Up</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Your <rt.absorb>Hold the Line</> cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds each time you use <rt.absorb>Shields Up</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: When you are <rt.bold>below 80% health</>, you gain <rt.bold>+5% Block Chance</> and <rt.heal>20% increased Healing taken</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: When you are <rt.bold>below 80% health</>, you gain <rt.bold>+5% Block Chance</> and <rt.heal>20% increased Healing taken</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> has <rt.warning>+20% additional critical strike chance</> and deals <rt.warning>100% increased damage to the first target it hits</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> has <rt.warning>+20% additional critical strike chance</> and deals <rt.warning>100% increased damage to the first target it hits</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: When your <rt.mana>Toughness</> has reduced an amount of damage equal to <rt.bold>30% of your Maximum Health</>, you gain <rt.effect>20% increased Strength</> for 8 sec.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: When your <rt.mana>Toughness</> has reduced an amount of damage equal to <rt.bold>30% of your Maximum Health</>, you gain <rt.effect>20% increased Strength</> for 8 sec.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
While <rt.absorb>Siegebreaker</> is active you deal <rt.warning>25% more damage</> and <rt.bold>50% your damage reduction</> from <rt.mana>Toughness</> is shared with all allies.

Your <rt.warning>Spirit is increased by +5%</> and each time you use your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> abililty you <rt.mana>generate 2 Spirit Points</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString:
While <rt.absorb>Siegebreaker</> is active you deal <rt.warning>25% more damage</> and <rt.bold>50% your damage reduction</> from <rt.mana>Toughness</> is shared with all allies.

Your <rt.warning>Spirit is increased by +5%</> and each time you use your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> abililty you <rt.mana>generate 2 Spirit Points</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Each time you use <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</>, <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</>, <rt.absorb>Shockwave</>, and <rt.absorb>Shields Up</>, you gain <rt.heal>3.0% increased Armor</> for 3 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Upon expiration, 1 stack is lost.

Your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deals additional damage to all targets hit equal to <rt.warning>10% of your total Armor value</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString:
Each time you use <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</>, <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</>, <rt.absorb>Shockwave</>, and <rt.absorb>Shields Up</>, you gain <rt.heal>3.0% increased Armor</> for 3 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Upon expiration, 1 stack is lost.

Your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deals additional damage to all targets hit equal to <rt.warning>10% of your total Armor value</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> reduces damage taken by an <rt.heal>additional 5%</> on each <rt.mana>Toughness</> Tier.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> reduces damage taken by an <rt.heal>additional 5%</> on each <rt.mana>Toughness</> Tier.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Each time you <rt.bold>Block</> an attack, the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Grand Melee</> is reduced by 0.2 seconds.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Each time you <rt.bold>Block</> an attack, the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Grand Melee</> is reduced by 0.2 seconds.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> grants an additional <rt.mana>10% Toughness</> and  <rt.warning>deals up to 30% increased damage</> based on how much  <rt.mana>Toughness</> you have.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> grants an additional <rt.mana>10% Toughness</> and  <rt.warning>deals up to 30% increased damage</> based on how much  <rt.mana>Toughness</> you have.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Your <rt.absorb>Hold the Line</> ability increases your movement speed by 50% and the movement speed of your allies by 25% for 5 seconds.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Your <rt.absorb>Hold the Line</> ability increases your movement speed by 50% and the movement speed of your allies by 25% for 5 seconds.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: Your <bold>Armor is increased by 20%</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: Your <bold>Armor is increased by 20%</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString: While <rt.absorb>Shields up</> is active you gain an additional <rt.bold>+20% chance to block</>, all healing effects on you are <rt.heal>increased by 20%</>, and your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deals <rt.warning>40% increased damage</>.
DetailedDescription.LocalizedString: While <rt.absorb>Shields up</> is active you gain an additional <rt.bold>+20% chance to block</>, all healing effects on you are <rt.heal>increased by 20%</>, and your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deals <rt.warning>40% increased damage</>.

DetailedDescription.SourceString:
Your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> applies 1 stack of <rt.effect>Resonant Bulwark</> to the target, up to 20 stacks. Critical Strikes apply 2 stacks.

Your next <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> consumes all <rt.effect>Resonant Bulwark</> stacks on all targets hit, and <rt.warning>deals 10% more damage to those targets per stack consumed</> and <rt.effect>Stuns them for 0.2s per stack consumed</>.
